maria (Support): Hey team — customer C-834 reports invoice > SDK estimate. Console shows 487 tokens for a single chat call, but their client SDK reported 420. Can someone help triage? Attaching curl + response they used below.

maria (Support): curl repro:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood-2.1",
    "messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Give a short summary of the latest Q1 fundraising update."}
    ],
    "functions":[
      {"name":"web_search","description":"search web","parameters":{}}
    ],
    "function_call":"auto",
    "stream":false
  }'
```

maria (Support): server response snippet (from console API logs):

```
{"id":"chatcmpl-abc","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"... (includes function call result)"}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":120,"completion_tokens":367,"total_tokens":487}}
```

maria (Support): SDK snippet customer used (JS estimator):

```js
const est = sdk.tokenEstimate({model:'redwood-2.1', messages});
console.log('estimate', est.total); // 420
```

maria (Support): Their invoice line shows 487. They want to know why SDK estimator is lower and whether they were overbilled.

ev
a (SDK): @maria (Support) thanks — a couple quick Qs: was the function actually executed (i.e., did the assistant return a function call + tool output)? also was stream=true in the live flow?

maria (Support): yes — function executed and assistant message includes the tool output in the completion. Customer says they used streaming on the client for other calls, but this particular repro was non-streaming.

ev
a (SDK): hmm likely the estimator only accounted for the prompt side (system + user messages) and any assistant tokens produced directly by the model, but it may not include tokens added by the tool/function output that gets embedded into the assistant's message, nor any hidden system tokens inserted by the model runtime.

ev
a (SDK): can you paste the full messages array the customer actually sent (including the assistant.function_call and the function output if available)? without that we can only guess.

maria (Support): pasted below (sanitized):

```
[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
 {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the fundraising notes."},
 {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"web_search","arguments":"{\"q\":\"redwood fundraising q1\"}"}},
 {"role":"function","name":"web_search","content":"Found 3 articles: ... (approx 150 tokens)"},
 {"role":"assistant","content":"Final summary combining results."}
]
```

maria (Support): note: the function content line is the ~150 token blob the tool returned.

ev
a (SDK): OK that explains it. Server-side billing/usage counts any tokens the model consumes or emits, including the function output tokens that are fed back into the assistant message (they count toward completion_tokens). Our client estimator historically skipped function outputs by default to avoid double-counting in some tool-integration patterns — we tried to be conservative but that creates this discrepancy.

ev
a (SDK): immediate options:
- For customers: use the Console request-level usage view or the API response "usage" object to reconcile actual billed tokens.
- For SDK: we can add an explicit flag so estimator includes function responses and assistant insertions (e.g., includeFunctionResponses: true).

ev
a (SDK): i'll open a PR to add that flag and update the docs with an example.

kevin (Billing): to clarify billing rules: invoices are generated from the server-side total_tokens reported by the model runtime. That includes prompt tokens, model-generated tokens, any tool/function outputs that are incorporated into assistant messages, and special separator/delimiter tokens the model injects. If a function call returns text that is then passed back to the assistant, those bytes are tokenized and charged as completion_tokens.

kevin (Billing): in short — the invoice is correct per our metering. But customer confusion is valid because SDK estimator didn't include the function output by default.

maria (Support): customer is worried about large charge — can we do a one-off adjustment while we fix docs/SDK?

kevin (Billing): yes — we're offering to credit the delta for C-834 pending verification. Please attach the request id and the invoice line. I'll route to ops for a quick audit. :+1:

maria (Support): added invoice #INV-2026-324 and request id chatcmpl-abc in the ticket. thanks.

ev
a (SDK): opened PR #457 to expose includeFunctionResponses on tokenEstimate and updated README with a reconciliation note (link to PR in the ticket). :tada:

metering-bot: Reminder: per-account usage logs retained for 90 days; if you need raw tokenization diffs we can run a re-tokenization job (internal) to reproduce exactly how the server measured tokens.

kevin (Billing): please run the re-tokenization job for chatcmpl-abc and DM me results. If it matches console usage we'll credit difference.

maria (Support): will follow up with customer once re-tokenization completes. Marking as high priority. :eyes:

ev
a (SDK): note for docs: include example showing how function outputs get tokenized and counted, plus the SDK flag snippet.

maria (Support): thanks everyone — closing loop after audit.
